spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, diciendo: El acercante sacrificio de sus pazes a Jehová traerá su ofrenda a Jehová desde sacrificio de sus pazes.

findings.issue: The hiphil participle is the person who brings the sacrifice near; את marks זֶבַח as that participle’s object, and that same person is the subject of יָבִיא. “El acercante sacrificio … traerá” makes the sacrifice the one that brings the offering.
H8002 is a plural noun with a 3ms suffix (his peace-offerings). “pazes” substitutes abstract peaces and drops that offering noun.

notes: Address, Israel, Jehová twice, traerá, su ofrenda, and desde otherwise match the tokens; both זֶבַח phrases are repeated.
